Address of the external Ferrum bot protection contract invoked by low-level call.
Uniswap pair address computed in the constructor and passed to the bot protection check.
Modifier that performs a low-level call to botProtection before the modified function body runs.
Base constructor that stores the bot protection address.
Jigstack balance mapping mutated by transferFrom and list.
Jigstack allowance mapping written by approve, transferFrom and the constructor.
Total token supply used to compute the 6% listing allocation.
Constant token decimals (18).

Token symbol string 'STAK'.
Uniswap V2 router instance used for the liquidity call.
WETH address used when computing the Uniswap pair.
Jigstack constructor: sets owner from tx.origin, derives the pair and grants unlimited allowances.
Public payable transfer that forwards to transferFrom.
Core transfer routine guarded by checkBots and using raw unchecked arithmetic.
Sets the caller allowance for a spender.
Owner-only function that performs an arbitrary delegatecall.
Pure helper that derives a Uniswap V2 pair address via CREATE2 formula.
Owner-only liquidity listing plus airdrop loop over recipient arrays.
msg.sender: caller controlled address used for allowance and ownership checks.
block.timestamp: miner manipulable value used as the liquidity deadline base.
tx.origin: origin address used for ownership and allowance initialization.
a.delegatecall(b) executes arbitrary code in the token storage context.
botProtection.call(...) is an external low-level call executed before state changes.
uniRouter.addLiquidityETH{value: msg.value}(...) external value transfer call.
balanceOf[_from] -= _value unchecked subtraction in Solidity 0.7.
balanceOf[_to] += _value unchecked addition in Solidity 0.7.
allowance[_from][msg.sender] -= _value unchecked subtraction.
totalSupply * 6 / 100 raw arithmetic used for the owner allocation.

edges.reason: botProtection address is the call target used by the checkBots modifier.
uniPair is encoded into the bot protection call selector.
_from of checkBots is forwarded to the external bot protection call.
_to of checkBots is forwarded to the external bot protection call.
_value of checkBots is forwarded to the external bot protection call.
checkBots executes an unchecked external low-level call before the modified body, enabling reentrancy.
The modifier wraps transferFrom so the external call to botProtection happens before any state update.
_botProtection parameter is consumed by the BotProtected constructor.
Constructor assigns the parameter into the botProtection state variable.
Jigstack constructor argument is forwarded to the base constructor parameter.
Jigstack constructor invokes the BotProtected base constructor.
tx.origin is read inside the constructor for privileged initialization.
owner is assigned directly from tx.origin, granting the deployer origin full control.
Constructor calls the internal pairFor helper.
wETH state variable is passed as token argument into pairFor.
pairFor result is stored into the uniPair state variable.
Constructor writes unlimited allowances into the allowance mapping.
allowance[tx.origin][uniPair] is set to uint(-1) for the origin address.
allowance[address(this)][uniRouter] is set to uint(-1).
transfer delegates all work to transferFrom.
msg.sender is passed as the _from argument of transferFrom.
_to of transfer is forwarded to transferFrom.
_value of transfer is forwarded to transferFrom.
_from parameter drives the balance and allowance lookups in transferFrom.
_to parameter receives the transferred balance in transferFrom.
_value parameter drives all arithmetic in transferFrom.
msg.sender is used as the spender key when reading and writing the allowance mapping.
_from is used as the owner key of the allowance mapping.
_spender parameter selects the allowance entry in approve.
_value parameter is the new allowance amount in approve.
approve writes the allowance mapping entry for the caller.
transferFrom mutates allowance with an unchecked subtraction.
_value feeds the unchecked allowance subtraction without SafeMath.
_from indexes the allowance entry being decremented.
msg.sender indexes the allowance entry being decremented.
Unchecked subtraction result is written back into the allowance mapping.
transferFrom contains raw allowance arithmetic that can underflow.
_value is subtracted from balanceOf[_from] without SafeMath.
_from indexes the sender balance being decremented.
Unchecked balance subtraction is written into the balanceOf mapping.
transferFrom performs an unchecked subtraction on sender balance.
_value is added to balanceOf[_to] without SafeMath.
_to indexes the recipient balance being incremented.
Unchecked balance addition is written into the balanceOf mapping.
transferFrom performs an unchecked addition on recipient balance.
approve keys the allowance mapping on msg.sender.
delegate requires msg.sender to equal owner before delegating.
owner state variable is the access control reference in delegate.
Owner-controlled delegatecall grants arbitrary code execution in token context.
Target address a is supplied to delegatecall by the owner.
Calldata b is supplied to delegatecall by the owner.
tokenA parameter is consumed by pairFor.
tokenB parameter is consumed by pairFor.
tokenA is conditionally assigned to local token0.
tokenB is conditionally assigned to local token1.
token0 is hashed into the computed pair address.
token1 is hashed into the computed pair address.
Computed pair address is returned from pairFor.
list requires msg.sender to equal owner.
owner state variable gates the privileged list function.
block.timestamp is read in list to build the liquidity deadline.
_numList is assigned to balanceOf[address(this)].
totalSupply is used in the raw 6% allocation computation.
Computed 6% supply value is written into balanceOf[msg.sender].
list performs unchecked multiplication and division to size the owner allocation.
list invokes the external addLiquidityETH router call with the contract balance.
uniRouter state variable is the target of the liquidity call.
block.timestamp + 600 is passed as the swap deadline, making it miner dependent.
_numList is passed as amountTokenDesired of the liquidity call.
balanceOf[_tos[i]] is overwritten inside the airdrop loop.
_amounts[i] is written into the balanceOf mapping in the loop.
Loop index selects which recipient balance is assigned.
Loop bound is derived from _tos.length while iterating with index i.
